# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for security problems. Use GitHub's private
reporting instead: open the **Security** tab of this repository and choose
**Report a vulnerability**. Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and the
affected version or commit.

If **Report a vulnerability** is not available, open a regular issue titled
"Security contact request" with no technical details (do not describe the
vulnerability there) and we will arrange a private channel to receive the report.

We will acknowledge a report as soon as we can and keep you updated while we
investigate and fix it.

## Scope

This project is end-to-end encrypted (see `PRIVACY.md`). Reports about the
encryption, authentication, or sync layers are especially welcome.
